title: DALL·E: Creating images from text
summary: We’ve trained a neural network called DALL·E that creates images from text captions for a wide range of concepts expressible in natural language.
body: We’ve trained a neural network called DALL·E that creates images from text captions for a wide range of concepts expressible in natural language.
summaryZh: OpenAI训练并介绍了DALL-E模型，这是一个能够根据广泛自然语言文本描述直接生成高质量图像的神经网络系统。原始信息显示：We’ve trained a neural network called DALL·E that creates images from text captions for a wide range of concepts expressible in natural language.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“DALL·E: Creating images from text”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了能够根据自然语言文本直接生成图像的DALL-E模型，推动了文本到图像生成技术的发展。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
